                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "39.44"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "6.56"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "23.75"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "22.58"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Identify the class with the highest frequency: 20-30 has the maximum frequency of 35.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Use the grouped mode formula: Mode = L + [(f1 − f0) ÷ (2f1 − f0 − f2)] × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Substitute L = 20, f1 = 35, f0 = 29, f2 = 25, h = 10.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mode = 20 + [(35 − 29) ÷ (70 − 54)] × 10 = 20 + 3.75 = 23.75 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 23.75 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Frequency distribution of ages of patients.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Maximum frequency is 35, which corresponds to the class interval 20-30.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mode of grouped data is given by:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mode = L + [ (f1 − f0) ÷ (2f1 − f0 − f2) ] × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Where:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      L = Lower limit of the modal class

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      f1 = Frequency of the modal class

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      f0 = Frequency of the class preceding the modal class

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      f2 = Frequency of the class succeeding the modal class

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      h = Width of the class interval

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      From the given data, the modal class is 20-30 because it has the highest frequency of 35.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ L = 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ f1 = 35

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ f0 = 29

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ f2 = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ h = 30 − 20 = 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Substituting these values into the formula:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Mode = 20 + [ (35 − 29) ÷ (2 × 35 − 29 − 25) ] × 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Mode = 20 + [ 6 ÷ (70 − 54) ] × 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Mode = 20 + [ 6 ÷ 16 ] × 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Mode = 20 + 0.375 × 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Mode = 20 + 3.75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Mode = 23.75 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Option Analysis:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Option (1) 39.44 is incorrect because the mode must lie within the modal class interval of 20-30.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Option (2) 6.56 is incorrect as it lies completely outside the range of the given data classes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 23.75 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Empirical Relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Median of Grouped Data

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Median = L + [ (N/2 − CF) ÷ f ] × h, where L is the lower limit of the median class, CF is the cumulative frequency of the preceding class, f is the frequency of the median class, and h is the class width.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mean of Grouped Data (Direct Method)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mean = Σ(fi × xi) ÷ Σfi, where xi is the class mark (midpoint) of each class interval and fi is the corresponding frequency. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      उच्चतम आवृत्ति वाले वर्ग की पहचान करें: 20-30 की अधिकतम आवृत्ति 35 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      वर्गीकृत बहुलक सूत्र का उपयोग करें: Mode = L + [(f1 − f0) ÷ (2f1 − f0 − f2)] x h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      L = 20, f1 = 35, f0 = 29, f2 = 25, h = 10 मान रखें।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mode = 20 + [(35 − 29) ÷ (70 − 54)] x 10 = 20 + 3.75 = 23.75 वर्ष।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर 23.75 वर्ष है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      रोगियों की आयु का आवृत्ति वितरण।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      अधिकतम आवृत्ति 35 है, जो वर्ग अंतराल 20-30 के संगत है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      वर्गीकृत आँकड़ों का बहुलक (Mode) इस प्रकार दिया जाता है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mode = L + [ (f1 − f0) ÷ (2f1 − f0 − f2) ] x h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      जहाँ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      L = बहुलक वर्ग की निचली सीमा

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      f1 = बहुलक वर्ग की आवृत्ति

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      f0 = बहुलक वर्ग से ठीक पहले वाले वर्ग की आवृत्ति

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      f2 = बहुलक वर्ग के ठीक बाद वाले वर्ग की आवृत्ति

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      h = वर्ग अंतराल की चौड़ाई

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ఇచ్చినది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      తరగతి అంతరాలు మరియు పౌనఃపున్యాలు: 10-20 → 29, 20-30 → 35, 30-40 → 25, 40-50 → 10, 50-60 → 18, 60-70 → 34, 70-80 → 17

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\text{బాహుళకం} = L + \\dfrac{(f_1 - f_0)}{(2f_1 - f_0 - f_2)} \\times h\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ఇక్కడ: L = బాహుళక తరగతి యొక్క దిగువ పరిమితి f₁ = బాహుళక తరగతి యొక్క పౌనఃపున్యం f₀ = మునుపటి తరగతి యొక్క పౌనఃపున్యం f₂ = తదుపరి తరగతి యొక్క పౌనఃపున్యం h = తరగతి వెడల్పు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      లెక్కలు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      బాహుళక తరగతి = అత్యధిక పౌనఃపున్యం కలిగిన తరగతి = 20-30 (f₁ = 35) f₀ = 29 (మునుపటి తరగతి), f₂ = 25 (తదుపరి తరగతి), L = 20, h = 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ బాహుళకం = 20 + ((35 − 29) ÷ (2x35 − 29 − 25)) x 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ బాహుళకం = 20 + (6 ÷ (70 − 54)) x 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ బాహుళకం = 20 + (6 ÷ 16) x 10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ బాహుళకం = 20 + (0.375 x 10)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ బాహుళకం = 20 + 3.75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ బాహుళకం = 23.75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ బాహుళకం = 23.75 సంవత్సరాలు.
